SEARCH
Package neqsim.process.equipment.network

Class FieldNetworkTopology

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.network.FieldNetworkTopology
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class FieldNetworkTopology extends Object implements Serializable
Typed field and SURF identity view over a LoopedPipeNetwork.

This class deliberately does not own another hydraulic graph. Every field node and edge identifier is the identifier of the corresponding node or edge in the wrapped LoopedPipeNetwork. The view adds stable equipment tags, field roles, services, named ports and execution diagnostics while the wrapped network remains the sole owner of connectivity, fluids, pressure-flow equations, conservative junction mixing and optimization state.

Equipment bindings are optional runtime references to normal NeqSim process equipment. They are not serialized; stable identifiers, tags and ports are serialized so a replayed definition can be rebound to equipment in a ProcessSystem or ProcessModel without duplicating those objects.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Even Solbraa

    • addLiveWellNode

      public FieldNetworkTopology.FieldNode addLiveWellNode(String id, String equipmentTag, FieldNetworkTopology.NodeRole role, FieldNetworkTopology.Service service, double initialPressureBar, double elevationM)
      Add a live well boundary whose pressure and rate are solved by FieldWellNetworkCoupler.

      The underlying hydraulic node is a normal free-pressure source for production or sink for injection. The coupler writes a conservative production supply or injection demand at this node and iterates the existing live well equipment against the pressure solved by LoopedPipeNetwork. No additional graph or hydraulic element is created.

      Parameters:
      id - stable field and hydraulic node identity
      equipmentTag - engineering equipment tag
      role - FieldNetworkTopology.NodeRole.PRODUCTION_WELL or FieldNetworkTopology.NodeRole.INJECTION_WELL
      service - matching production or injection service
      initialPressureBar - positive initial pressure in bara
      elevationM - node elevation in metres
      Returns:
      typed field node
